questions.evidence:
Museum group chat: Our visit begins at ten, but the audio desk opens at nine thirty. Please bring headphones with a wire. The museum lends players for free, although it has only twelve sets of headphones for a group of twenty students.

Eva: My headphones have no wire. Can I still use the player? Guide: You may borrow museum headphones if any remain. The player does not connect to wireless headphones. You can also read the printed guide beside each display.

Jun: I will bring my own wired pair, so someone else can borrow one. Eva: Thanks. I will arrive early. If all twelve are taken, I will use the printed guide and ask you about anything I do not understand.

Guide: Good plan. Please return borrowed equipment before leaving. The printed guides must stay in the museum too. You may write notes in your own notebook, but do not take the display cards away.
